statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ (r z : K) (l j : ℕ), 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖ < 1 → ‖z‖=1 → ‖z+z⁻¹‖=1 → 0 < j → j < l → ‖theta (r^(2*l)) z / theta (r^(2*l)) (r^j*z)‖ = ‖r‖^j

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 缩放对数与 Theta 值 · JA-0015 · 从实际双边级数求单标签比值的范数
plain_statement.en: New route · Scaled logarithms and theta values · JA-0015 · Evaluate the norm of the one-label ratio of actual theta series

brief.zh: 证明两尾趋零；分子有两首项，分母在 −1 唯一取最大范数。
brief.en: Show convergence in both tails. The numerator has two leading terms and the denominator has a unique norm maximum at −1.
